resources.string: Not just an AI—she\'s someone who remembers you
She remembers what you tell her, and can bring it up long after.
She has her own moods and life, so her tone isn\'t always the same.
She sometimes reaches out first, like she\'s really waiting for your reply.
Chats only grow, never shrink. Anything you\'d rather forget can go to the recycle bin.
Add your own key and she really comes to life. Or skip for now and look around in demo mode.
Pick an identity and a way of speaking. You can change both anytime in Settings.
She\'ll remember this name. Leave it blank and she\'ll just call you “you”.
She may reach out when the time feels right. Allow notifications so you don\'t miss her messages. Saying no is fine too—you\'ll still see everything in the app.
Notifications: get an alert when she messages you first.
Exact alarms: so good mornings, good nights and little moments aren\'t delayed by the system.
Battery optimization exemption: on aggressive devices, she stays reachable.
Long-press a message to quote, edit or unsend it; her memory gets corrected too.
Chats are never deleted—removing one just sends it to the recycle bin, where you can always get it back.
In Settings you can change her identity and speaking style, and back up or restore your data.
Clearing app data lets you go through onboarding again.
